Mega Evolution series · CRI

Chaos Rising

Released May 22, 2026 · 122 cards

StandardExpanded

Chaos Rising is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on May 22, 2026. Its main set has 86 cards, plus 36 secret rares numbered beyond the set (122 in total). It includes 97 Pokémon, 22 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

83 illustrators worked on Chaos Rising. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (11), MARINA Chikazawa (4), Souichirou Gunjima (4), Studio Bora Inc. (4), Susumu Maeya (3), takuyoa (3), Akira Komayama (2), aky CG Works (2).
